jobs.title: Transaction Banking (TxB), Product Management, Vice President, London
jobs.location: London, Greater London, England, United Kingdom
jobs.description:
TRANSACTION BANKING (TxB)
We aim to build a modern and digital-first transaction banking solution to serve our clients. Our business combines the strength, heritage, and expertise of a 150-year-old firm with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of a tech start-up. Transaction Banking (TxB) provides a cloud-based global platform to serve clients’ treasury needs, including deposits, payments, and sophisticated liquidity options in over 160 countries.
Having successfully established our presence in the US and UK, we are rapidly expanding our capabilities across continental Europe through our key hubs like Frankfurt and Amsterdam. Our goal is to provide a best-in-class digital product that helps European corporate and institutional clients succeed by giving them a holistic view of their treasury and FX operations. Built entirely on a modern, API-first cloud infrastructure, we are the clear alternative to legacy bank systems. We are a team of diverse experts helping our clients shape the future of their global treasury.
WHAT WE LOOK FOR
Goldman Sachs Product Solutions Specialists are innovators, problem-solvers, and enablers. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. For our European team, we are seeking a specialist who combines a strong sales mindset with specialized expertise in Foreign Exchange (FX) and domestic European transaction systems.
Our solution specialists bring modern treasury designs to life by working closely with clients, engineers, and product managers. We look for professionals who can navigate complex technical conversations with client developers while confidently presenting cross-border FX and liquidity strategies to CFOs and Corporate Treasurers. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of European payment networks, regional clearing mechanics, and how corporate ERP and Treasury Management Systems (TMS) handle cross-currency flows.
THE ROLE
This is a key leadership role based in Europe (with primary hubs in London, Frankfurt, or Amsterdam) working closely with our Product, Engineering, and Sales teams, and interacting directly with clients. We are looking for a solutions specialist with deep subject matter expertise in corporate FX, cross-border payment flows, and regional European transaction rails.
The work starts with designing end-to-end treasury and payment architectures that address our European clients’ localized and global requirements. The role demands an in-depth understanding of the European payments landscape—including SEPA, SEPA Instant, T2 (TARGET2), CHAPS, and FPS —and how these networks interface with global SWIFT messaging and ISO 20022 standards.
As a key member of the Product Solutions team, you will drive the sales cycle alongside our corporate sales division. You will structure tailored FX solutions, embed cross-currency automated flows into client treasuries, and optimize regional liquidity management. Additionally, you will lead complex post-sale integrations, advising client developers on API connectivity, host-to-host file transfers, and secure data exchange protocols (such as EBICS and eIDAS-compliant open banking standards).
RESPONSIBILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS
- Solution Architecture: Design comprehensive, end-to-end treasury and payment solutions for European corporate and institutional clients, with a focus on embedding cross-border FX execution into transactional workflows.
- FX Sales Enablement: Act as the subject matter expert during the sales cycle to pitch complex corporate FX, cross-currency clearing, and multi-currency virtual account solutions.
- Technical Client Advisory: Lead technical white-boarding sessions, integration workshops, and product demonstrations focusing on API integration, SWIFT connectivity, and ERP/TMS configurations.
- Regional Rail Integration: Navigate and advise clients on optimization opportunities across European payment networks, including SEPA schemes, T2 (RTGS), CHAPS, and instant payment infrastructures.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with global Engineering, Product Management, and Implementation teams to feedback regional market trends and translate European regulatory shifts (e.g., PSD3, instant payment mandates) into product features.
- Project Management: Seamlessly manage multiple complex integration projects and client relationships simultaneously, ensuring smooth onboarding and quick time-to-value.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- Professional Experience: Minimum of 7+ years of relevant experience in transaction banking, corporate FX sales, payment consulting, or pre-sales engineering.
- FX & Liquidity Expertise: Proven track record in corporate FX solutions, cross-border payments, multi-currency pricing, and working knowledge of risk management/hedging interfaces.
- European Rails & Standards: Comprehensive technical and functional understanding of European clearing networks (SEPA Credit Transfer, SEPA Instant, T2/TARGET2, CHAPS, FPS).
- Messaging & Data Standards: Deep expertise in ISO 20022 XML standards and SWIFT message types (MT and MX) across payments, cash management, and treasury domains.
- Connectivity & Integration: Strong familiarity with secure file transfer protocols, host-to-host connectivity, open banking APIs, and regional communication standards like EBICS.
- ERP & TMS Knowledge: Practical understanding of how top-tier Corporate Treasuries integrate via ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and Treasury Management Systems (e.g., Kyriba, FIS).
- Education: Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.
- Communication: Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with the ability to confidently present technical designs to client developers and treasury solutions to CFOs

YOUR IMPACT

Are you a quick-thinking self-starter with a passion for the all facets of personal financial, have the desire to work closely with high net worth individuals and the ability to think outside the box?  Our executive financial counseling professionals provide proactive financial counseling, full-service implementation, including tax preparation and investments, to address complexities of executives, entrepreneurs and high net worth individuals?  We are seeking professionals with an understanding of the markets who have the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, strong communication skills, and client service are essential to maintaining and enhancing our business.

OUR IMPACT

Goldman Sachs Ayco partners with Fortune 1000 companies to design and implement tailored financial planning programs for their workforce—leveraging the 50-year heritage of Ayco and the comprehensive resources of Goldman Sachs to meet the evolving needs of their employees. Ayco believes companies best serve their stakeholders and the greater economy when their employees’ financial lives are clear, understood and in their control. Ayco advisors and technical specialists help clients achieve their personal financial goals through education and guided implementation across seven key financial disciplines, including employee benefit planning.

WEALTH STRATEGIES GROUP (WSG)

Goldman Sachs Ayco’s Wealth Strategies group provides risk management solutions in support of advisors and clients across all segments of Goldman’s Wealth Management business. We are on a journey to transform, modernize and scale the business, which currently generates over $1.4B of Life, Annuity and Long-Term care new business premiums on an annual basis. Our planning focused practice currently has 56 team members operating in 7 wealth management offices across the county.

HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL

- Educate and support Wealth Advisors and their teams in the planning, design and implementation of sophisticated wealth transfer and tax-advantaged life insurance strategies. This will include knowledge of diverse insurance policy structures, trust structures such as Revocable Living Trusts, Irrevocable Life Insurance Trusts (ILITs), Intentionally Defective Grantor Trusts (IDGTs) and funding strategies including gifting and loans, both intra-family and third party.
- Knowledge of alternative and complementary non-insurance planning will be essential to compare and contrast planning opportunities. Experience with Grantor Retained Annuity Trusts, (GRATs), Qualified Personal Residence Trusts (QPRTs), Irrevocable Gift Trusts (IGTs), Family Limited Partnerships (FLPs) and other sophisticated planning techniques allows for a consultative approach to planning.
- Work directly with Wealth Advisor teams in existing and prospective client relationships to identify planning opportunities.
- Conduct client presentations regarding wealth transfer and tax-advantaged accumulation strategies including recommending suitable implementation.
- Drive Wealth Advisors to prioritize identification, presentation and implementation of suitable planning.
- Liaise between Wealth Advisor Teams and internal Underwriting and Implementation Teams to implement planning including the drafting, review and execution of trusts for trust owned policies. Engage in direct and indirect work with third party estate planning attorneys and institutional trustee services.
- Partner with Product Analysis Team to enhance product and strategy portfolio based on changes in the product landscape, market conditions or applicable tax law.
- Identify new or alternative planning opportunities via understanding changing client dynamics including wealth demographics, client tenure, multi-generational engagement and building on existing planning.
- Responsible for meeting goals set for your specific Wealth Advisors which contribute to the overall unit goals
- Enhance the client experience through exemplary client service standards
- Demonstrate strong leadership skills, acting as a role model for other associates. Partner with senior management on key initiatives and the growth and development of our team.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Bachelor’s degree required
- Advanced degree or designation such as CFP
- Series 7 or Series 6 required
- Life and health insurance license required
- Minimum three years’ experience in life insurance sales is required
- Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
- Direct client facing experience and demonstrated ability to build and foster strong network of relationships.
- Must have demonstrated the ability to be detail-oriented, self-motivated and capable of working in a team environment
- Demonstrated ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs (ex. Outlook, Excel and Word)

jobs.description:
Role Summary
The Core Engineering is seeking an experienced AI Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and adoption of AI-powered capabilities across enterprise platforms and business workflows. Reporting to the Head of Product for Core Engineering, this role will be responsible for identifying opportunities to apply AI, automation, and intelligent workflow technologies across Human Resources, Finance, Expense Management, Procurement, and other enterprise functions.
This individual will serve as a subject matter expert in leveraging AI to transform how work gets done across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep business process expertise with strong product management capabilities and practical knowledge of modern AI technologies. They must be able to connect the dots across business domains, identify common patterns and opportunities, and drive horizontal solutions that can be scaled across multiple functions rather than creating isolated point solutions.

Key Responsibilities
• Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and investment strategy for AI-powered enterprise workflow solutions.
• Identify and prioritize opportunities to leverage generative AI, AI agents, machine learning, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration technologies to improve operational effectiveness.
• Partner closely with stakeholders across HR, Finance, Expense Management, Procurement, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to understand business challenges and identify high-impact use cases.
• Develop a deep understanding of enterprise workflows and operating models to uncover opportunities for standardization, simplification, automation, and AI enablement.
• Drive the creation of scalable, cross-functional solutions that can be leveraged across multiple business areas rather than point solutions designed for individual teams.
• Translate business requirements into clear product capabilities, technical requirements, and measurable outcomes.
• Lead all phases of the product lifecycle, including discovery, business case development, solution design, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and post-launch optimization.
• Establish success metrics, monitor adoption and business impact, and continuously refine products based on user feedback and performance data.
• Partner with Engineering, Data, Architecture, Security, and Platform teams to deliver enterprise-grade AI solutions.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, bringing innovative ideas and practical applications into the organization.
• Develop executive communications, investment proposals, roadmap presentations, and product updates for senior stakeholders.

Required Qualifications
• 10+ years of experience in product management, digital transformation, enterprise technology, or related leadership roles.
• Demonstrated experience delivering AI, automation, workflow, or enterprise platform solutions at scale.
• Strong domain expertise in one or more of the following areas:
- Human Resources
- Finance
- Expense Management
• Proven experience redesigning business processes and operating models through technology, automation, and AI.
• Ability to identify common business challenges across functions and create scalable, enterprise-wide solutions.
• Experience gathering requirements from senior business stakeholders and translating them into actionable product roadmaps.
• Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and executive influence skills.
• Experience working in agile product development environments and leading cross-functional teams.
• Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and drive execution across complex organizations.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Oracle and/or SAP platforms, including workflow automation, process optimization, enterprise integrations, and platform modernization initiatives.
• Strong understanding of enterprise systems supporting HR, Finance, Procurement, Expense Management, or related business functions.
• Knowledge of enterprise data architecture, governance, security, compliance, and regulatory considerations.
• Familiarity with large language models, generative AI platforms, AI agents, RAG architectures, workflow orchestration frameworks, and intelligent automation technologies.
• Experience developing business cases, operating models, and ROI frameworks for AI investments.
• Experience leading enterprise platform strategies that span multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.

Success Profile
The successful candidate will be recognized as a trusted advisor and thought leader in applying AI to enterprise workflows. They will possess a unique combination of business process expertise, product leadership, systems thinking, and practical AI knowledge. Most importantly, they will demonstrate the ability to connect business needs across functions, identify common opportunities, and build scalable horizontal capabilities that drive measurable efficiency, productivity, and business value across The Core Engineering organization and the broader firm.

jobs.title: Global Banking & Markets - Transaction Banking - Channels Product Analyst - Dallas
jobs.description:
We're a team of diverse Treasury and Payments specialists helping our clients solution and build for the future. The Programmatic Channels team owns the "pipes" that move corporate payment instructions and data between our clients and our bank — including Corporate APIs, Open Banking APIs, SFTP and FileAct file transmission, SWIFT Fin and FinPlus messaging rails, and the canonical formats that convert diverse corporate customer inputs into standard, machine-readable payment files.
As an  Analyst Product Manager , you'll support the execution of our programmatic channels roadmap, working closely with engineers, implementation specialists, and treasury professionals to make sure client payment submissions are processed accurately, efficiently, and at scale though any of the channels. This is a hands-on role for someone who is energized by data, detail, and the operational backbone of corporate payments — and who wants to build a foundation in product management.

Responsibilities
- Support the day-to-day execution of the API and file-based channels roadmap
- Assist in the canonical conversion of varied client payment formats into our standardized internal payment formats, working with engineering to troubleshoot mapping and transformation logic.
- Analyze payment transmission and processing data to identify failure patterns, formatting errors, latency issues, and opportunities for automation or client education.
- Partner with customers, implementation and servicing teams on new feature requests and drive its delivery.
- Maintain and improve internal documentation, runbooks, and format guides used by engineering, implementation, and client-facing teams.
- Track and report on key operational metrics and help translate findings into prioritized backlog items.
- Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) for new payment formats, connectivity types, and channel enhancements.
- Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by flagging recurring pain points and proposing incremental fixes to formats, validation rules, or processes.

Qualifications
- 2–3 years of experience in product management, business analysis, operations, or a related role — ideally within payments, banking, or financial services.
- Experience in  API design and developer experience (DX)  — including RESTful API product management, developer portals, and API-first product strategy
- Background in  electronic payments  — including ACH, wires, SWIFT, real-time payments (RTP, FedNow, SEPA Instant), and cross-border payment flows
- Familiarity with file transfer protocols and standards ( SFTP, FileAct ) and/or payment messaging standards ( SWIFT MT, ISO 20022 ) is strongly preferred.
- Strong analytical skills, including comfort working with large datasets (Excel, SQL, or similar tools) to identify trends and root causes.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical file specifications into clear documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
- A detail-oriented, organized approach to managing feature delivery cycle: from initial client request to engineering requirements, testing to go-live.
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at the executive level

You may be a good fit for this role if you are enthusiastic and curious about:
- The business, technical, and/or operational aspects of payments and banking
- Electronic payments, real time payments, card networks, stablecoin payments, and emerging payment schemes
- The design of APIs and   have pride in best-in-class developer experience (DX) — including intuitive documentation, sandbox environments, and seamless onboarding for corporate clients and fintech partners
- Corporate treasury, cash management, and the inner workings of large corporates and financial institutions
- User experience (UX) design principles across all payment channel touchpoints, partnering with design teams to deliver interfaces and workflows that are elegant, intuitive, and client-centric
- Drive the integration and strategic application of Generative AI capabilities within payment channels — including intelligent payment routing, anomaly detection, client-facing assistants, and workflow automation
- Stay current on industry trends including ISO 20022 migration, real-time payments, open banking/APIs, card scheme innovations, and network-level VAS (e.g., SWIFT gpi, request-to-pay schemes)
- Ensuring all payment channel products comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., AML/KYC, data privacy such as GDPR/CCPA, PSD2 where applicable)
